name: Card
summary: Floating surface that groups related content.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no role: a Card is a <div> that draws a surface. Giving it role="region" would put an unnamed landmark in the tree on every card of a grid. When the whole card is a target, the interactive element goes INSIDE it — the `interactive` variant paints the surface, it does not make the div a button.

props.name: variant
props.type: base | raised | interactive | inset | outline | selected | danger | contrast
props.description: Which surface it is. `interactive` is the only one that answers the pointer, so use it only when the whole card really is a target; `inset` recesses instead of floating, which is what a panel inside a card wants. `contrast` stands out from the screen in both themes: in the light theme it is the dark theme's card, with no outline; in the dark theme it is the regular card with a yellow outline. Inside it the whole dark theme applies (data-theme="dark" on the card), so every child adjusts by itself. Do not use it in a list of choices: in the dark theme its outline is close to `selected`. `outline` has no fill of its own — it takes the colour of whatever it sits on — and keeps only the line around it: the big showcase box of a documentation home page.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. Padding comes from --card-pad and the 22px radius from --radius-card; neither is a prop, because the floating surface is the identity of the system.

props.name: render
props.description: The ELEMENT the card renders as, with the Aurea surface merged into it. Required when variant is "interactive": a card that is a target has to be a real target — <button> for an action, <a href> for navigation — and only you know which. tabIndex on a <div> would give focus with no role, no key and no accessible name.

props.name: accent
props.description: A colour stroke on the top edge, --accent-width (4) tall, in the tone's FILL colour, the same in both themes. It is decoration: the card's own title says the subject, so the stroke carries no information of its own. The other sides keep the regular 1px border, and the stroke wins over `selected`, `danger` and the `contrast` outline.

props.name: padding
props.description: none removes the inner padding so media bleeds to the edge; the 22 radius stays and clips the media.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` is the list mode: Card.Media on the left at thumbnail width (96, --space-24) and the content beside it.

props.name: Card.Media
props.description: The card's media part. Vertical, as first child, it bleeds to the top and side edges; horizontal, it sits on the left inside the padding, with the house's concentric radius (ADR-0033).

props.name: Card.Header
props.description: The header: the title and the description, together. 12 between the parts.

props.name: Card.Title
props.description: The card's title — an h3, 14/24 medium, as the reference. 12 between the parts.

props.name: Card.Description
props.description: The line under the title, 14/20 muted. 12 between the parts.

props.name: Card.Content
props.description: The body: a column with 4 between the items. 12 between the parts.

props.name: Card.Footer
props.description: The footer: a row (the buttons), 8 between them. 12 between the parts.
